## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows formatting standards (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`)
- [ ] Clippy passes without warnings (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] Tests pass across workspace (`cargo test --workspace --all-targets`)

- [ ] Updated relevant documentation in `docs/` and crate READMEs if applicable
